prompt.reglas:
Anything XL: an anime model (a merge of several anime SDXL models) that reads Danbooru tags.
Order: the character name, then the series (copyright), then the rating tag if the system does not set it, then Danbooru tags with as much detail as the request gives: count and subject (1girl, solo), hair, eyes, clothes, pose, expression, setting, lighting, composition. Never only "1girl": describe the picture.
Year tags change the drawing style: the system adds newest; add recent, mid, early or old only to ask for an older style.
Some tags may be weak in this model: if one detail matters most, weight it up to 1.5, like (red scarf:1.4).
Do not add quality words: the system already adds them. Never use high weights in the negative.
prompt.negativoFijo: lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, text, error, missing fingers, extra digit, fewer digits, cropped, worst quality, low quality, normal quality, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, username, blurry, artist name
